results.title: Gymnastics-England gymnast Langton conscious after heavy fall at Commonwealth Games
results.description: July 25 - England gymnast Gabriel Langton was conscious and speaking with doctors after being taken to hospital following a heavy fall during the men's team gymnastics final at the Commonwealth Games on Friday, team officials said.

results.title: LeBron James' NBA Journey: From Rookie Season With Cleveland Cavaliers To Historic 24th Season With Philadelphia 76ers
results.description: LeBron James is set to begin his unprecedented 24th NBA season after joining the Philadelphia 76ers from the Los Angeles Lakers. The NBA reflected on each of his debut campaigns, highlighting his longevity and evolution. At 41, James will partner with Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown in pursuit of another championship.
